explanation: Q1 groups by league name (which may combine multiple leagues with the same name) and counts total matches per name. Q2 groups by league_id (unique per league) and counts matches per league. If two leagues share the same name but have different match counts, and a third league with a distinct name has a higher individual match count than the sum of the two same-name leagues, Q1 returns the shared name (summed count), while Q2 returns the third league's name (higher individual count).
